title: Pipeline Triage Agent
description:
An LLM-assisted triage tool for Apache Airflow pipeline failures. It reads a failed task's logs, classifies the root cause, and may open a pull request with a suggested fix — but only when the root cause is one a repository change can actually address.

The archive includes a local Airflow harness that reproduces eight realistic pipeline failures with genuine tracebacks, and the complete data from a 480-diagnosis evaluation across three models: every diagnosis, every verified patch, and the captured failure evidence each diagnosis was shown.
